title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
abstract: arXiv:2608.03682v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physical AI policies require inference throughout their lifecycle, including model evaluation, cloud reinforcement learning rollout, edge GPU serving, and onboard deployment. Although these settings share the same checkpoint and action semantics, they often rely on separate inference programs. To unify them, we build PhyAI, a Physical AI inference engine with a single runtime that keeps architecture-specific conditioning, solver, cache, and output logic in model adapters while sharing graph execution, kernels, memory management, and parallel services. The same codebase runs vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) on single or multiple GPUs across onboard, edge, and cloud deployments. We used the adapter interface to add MiniCPM-Robot on the day of its release. PhyAI achieves 1.40x-4.65x speedups over the official implementations of pi0, pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MiniCPM-Robot. translated_title: PhyAI：边缘实时物理AI，云端可扩展回放
translated_abstract: 物理AI策略在其整个生命周期中都需要推理，包括模型评估、云端强化学习回放、边缘GPU服务以及板载部署。尽管这些场景共享相同的检查点和动作语义，但它们通常依赖独立的推理程序。为了统一这些场景，我们构建了PhyAI，一个物理AI推理引擎，具有单一运行时，将特定于架构的条件处理、求解器、缓存和输出逻辑保留在模型适配器中，同时共享图执行、内核、内存管理和并行服务。同一代码库可在板载、边缘和云端部署中，在单GPU或多GPU上运行视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAMs）。我们使用适配器接口在MiniCPM-Robot发布当天就添加了对其的支持。PhyAI在pi0、pi0.5、GR00T N1.7和MiniCPM-Robot的官方实现上实现了1.40倍至4.65倍的加速。在Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID上，它实现了...
tldr: PhyAI通过单一运行时和适配器接口统一了物理AI推理，在多个模型上实现了1.40倍至4.65倍的加速，并支持即时添加新模型。
en_tdlr: PhyAI unifies physical AI inference with a single runtime and adapter interface, achieving 1.40x-4.65x speedups across multiple models and enabling instant addition of new models.
